解答 方程组两边同时对 $t$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=\frac{2t}{1+t^2}，\frac{dy}{dt}=3+3t^2，\text{可得 }\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{3+3t^2}{\frac{2t}{1+t^2}}=\frac{3(1+t^2)^2}{2t}$$
